name: ast-ai-model-router
description: AST-aware Claude and Codex model routing for cost-conscious coding tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Pick Claude or Codex models from AST and task complexity signals.
interface.longDescription: AST AI Model Router analyzes JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python project structure plus the current task to choose an appropriate Claude or Codex model before launch. It is part of a token-economics toolkit for measuring, reducing, and routing LLM spend.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this repo and choose the right Codex model.
Route this Claude Code task by AST complexity.
Explain why this coding task needs a stronger model.
